title: Email/query: full article list loaded into memory before pagination
description: server.rs route_method Email/query: the overview_store.query_range loads all records between lo and hi, then handle_email_query sorts and paginates in memory. For a large group (100k articles), this allocates the full list on every query. The limit/position parameters should be pushed down to the database query in query_range. Currently the database query has no LIMIT or OFFSET, so all rows are always loaded. This matters when JMAP clients page through large mailboxes.
